purpose: Standalone real-storage experiments, not application tests
seed: deterministic index sequence; payload chars x; no random source
ordering: writers serialized by owning worker; replies optional; no automatic retries
notes: Queue jobs contain identities, not allocated payload buffers; upper bound is conservative. 3 seconds is a bounded screening/finalist sample, not long soak qualification. Sweep points are not product caps.
inline_history_cursor: alternating latest and halfway into retained sequence
topology_screen: reused one writer; optional reopen every transaction; optional two independent readers
batching_semantics: Already-formed batches supplied at batch/(20*active) second intervals; queue timer excludes formation. At20events/chat/s batch16 could wait750ms for remaining15events. This is throughput evidence, not user-visible durability freshness.
